verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a GPU hardware accelerator with no product interface in which a built-in assistant could live, so a delegate-to-built-in-assistant story is a category error for this product type. The evidence only says the card can run user-supplied AI agents locally ('running autonomous AI agents locally'). That is a host-compute capability, not a built-in assistant, and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
